edit.description: drive the scaffolded fixture through a verb that refuses on chain load
the agreement case, reading the fixture's verb out of the script

summary: `flume status` exits 0 over a chain that never loaded, so the install smoke's chain-load fixture step cannot fail — drive it through a refusing verb

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: The smoke run fails when the scaffolded chain is unreachable from where the installed CLI resolves it.
tests: the install smoke's chain-load fixture is verified by a CLI verb that exits non-zero when the chain is absent
notes: scripts/smoke-install.mjs:170 ends on `shim status`; status takes loadChainForObservation (src/cliChainLoad.ts), best-effort by contract — stderr only, exit unaffected. `flume check` refuses the same load (EX_MOUNT_DEAD, src/cli.ts:594) and exits 0 on an absent queue, so it costs one step. This is also what makes the script's `.flume` literal (:166-169) loud — see the plan commit body.
